hypothesis: Root cause: the SCRAM password of the Postgres replication user debezium was rotated, so Debezium cannot log in to the source database and pg-payments-connector task 0 failed.

verdict.reason: The hypothesis puts the rotated credential on the Postgres replication user and says source login failed. The truth is that the Kafka SASL principal's password was rotated and the broker rejected the connector. The failing connector task is in kafka-connect, so the first failing layer is right, but the root-cause layer is wrong (postgres instead of kafka).
